PART 1: Identify structures found different structures on the in the school for chart familiarization 118

What this means
In this part you learn to Identify structures found different structures on the in the school for chart familiarization 118. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Identify structures found different structures on the in the school for chart familiarization 118.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “: OUR SCHOOL” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Identify structures found different structures on the in the school for chart familiarization 118. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what : OUR SCHOOL is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “: OUR SCHOOL” around your school. (skill: Identify structures found different structures on the in the school for chart familiarization 118)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach : OUR SCHOOL to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Identify structures found different structures on the in the school for chart familiarization 118.
3. Make one local Kenya example of : OUR SCHOOL from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for : OUR SCHOOL: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study : OUR SCHOOL?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What work is done by different ENVIRONMENT 10 (Lessons) a) Talk about people in the school people in school?
2. What structures are found in the identification, walk round the school to school?
3. What are the colours of the flag?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what : OUR SCHOOL means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Identify structures found different structures on the in the school for chart familiarization 118.
